items.title: DMC 2.1.0: auto-update, news and a faster way to reach you
items.body: DMC now checks for new versions on start, downloads them quietly and asks you when to install. Updates are signature-checked; anything that fails the check is deleted and your install stays untouched.

items.title: Still in beta: please report what breaks
items.body: DMC is a beta. Scripts compiled for GTA SA Android and PC CLEO 4/5 are checked by automated tests, but not every script has been run in the game yet. If a compiled script misbehaves in game, open an issue and attach your script and %APPDATA%\DechrisModCompiler\dmc.log.

items.title: Tip: F6 compiles, F5 compiles and pushes to your phone
items.body: Connect the phone with USB debugging on, press F5, and the .csi is copied straight into the CLEO folder. Use Build > Decompile to open any compiled .csi as readable source.
